note: VM shapes the owner publishes measurements for. RTMR0 depends on every field (the ACPI tables QEMU generates: dstack-mr machine.rs/acpi.rs) and MRTD's page order on qemu_version, so each shape is its own golden manifest entry and a miner must launch exactly one of them (launch-td.sh). num_verity_volumes counts the read-only verity disks attached after the data disk: the worker image disk (measured into RTMR3 only, so a new worker image changes no other register), then one per weights image. pci_hole64_size is set on every GPU shape because the pinned dstack-mr models the 64-bit PCI window as a fixed base plus this size, while QEMU widens it to cover the GPUs' 64-bit BARs when its 32 GiB default is too small (CVM.md, 'The 64-bit PCI hole'; unverified on a TD). gpu_mode (spt, ppcie or mpt) goes into the manifest entry (publish.py) and changes no register. gpu_device_ids are the PCI vendor:device ids (pciutils pci.ids) kuno-preflight --host matches a server's GPUs against; they change no register either. CPU and memory sizes are proposals, not measured requirements.
